name: Rise
subtitle: Alarm clock with wake-up missions
description: Rise: alarms you have to get up to turn off. Built from source at github.com/HarveyK1/Rise-Alarm

apps.name: Rise
apps.subtitle: Alarm clock with wake-up missions
apps.localizedDescription: An alarm you have to get up to turn off. Wake-up missions (maths, shake, scan a code, memory tiles, typing, tap challenge, photo match, say the word), a lock-screen card, volume lock, gentle wake-up, backup siren, wake-up check, talking alarm, custom sounds, weather and wake-up streaks.

versions.localizedDescription: New app ID (app.risealarm.Rise): install Rise from this source again and delete the old copy. Otherwise the same as 0.7.1.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Rise uses the camera to scan your code or match your photo in wake-up missions.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Rise uses your location to show the weather where you are.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Rise listens for the word you say in the "Say the word" wake-up mission.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Rise turns what you say into text to check the "Say the word" mission.
